<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI signals extended tightening:</strong> The October MPC minutes indicate that rate cuts are off the table, with economists forecasting further repo rate hikes of up to 50 bps by December to address persistent inflation and interest rate gaps.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNMWhpMHYwZldralI3U3JBRXFBLVVuNjdwaE1GY1Vpbk9DWldZaTFicGhLbXRBVjZCYUFZZWVsVk9jaWhqalYyZXdTRktDNUpEaUFyYjNKUmhOdHpUS1hfRXVSSUZOaDc4ZGJSWGRXc2VkZEJvbWEzMWpHY2pyLWNWcWwwNm0zOGNYWUtRb1ZFUTFGWDRGVVNTYVJXTGdFc2FyR0JPZEx5Um5JejFOU08tenhB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I43</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Equities slide on macro headwinds:</strong> Indian markets faced a third consecutive day of losses, with the Sensex and Nifty declining as surging crude oil prices, rising global bond yields, and weak Asian sentiment dampened investor appetite.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude oil volatility weighs on assets:</strong> Brent crude prices breaching the $111/bbl mark have intensified inflationary concerns, pressuring the Indian rupee to 94.50 against the USD and dragging down domestic metal and power sector stocks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and election uncertainty:</strong> Global market sentiment remains fragile due to ongoing geopolitical tensions and uncertainty surrounding the US election cycle, which continues to drive volatility across emerging markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a></span></li>
</ul>
